title.narrative: Kampala Jinja Expressway Public Private Partnership Project (KJE) - NIP component

description.narrative: Construction of a greenfield limited access tolled expressway east from Kampala to relieve the current and future congestion on the Northern Corridor in and around the Greater Kampala. The project is referred to as the Kampala Jinja Expressway Public Private Partnership Project (KJE). The Project also includes urban and suburban sections and will be implemented through a Public-Private Partnership. The project is expected to be financed through a project finance arrangement that involves a mixture of debt, equity and grant financing
